speaker: NARRATOR
text: One morning, you sneeze... and the whole world stops.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Exactly ten seconds. Then it starts again.

speaker: MOM
text: ...and don't forget your lunch. Why are you staring at me?

speaker: YOU
text: No reason.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Final exam. You studied for zero minutes.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: So you pause time... and read the answer key. Upside down.

speaker: YOU
text: Is that a B... or an 8?

speaker: TEACHER
text: You got every question wrong. In a perfect pattern. How?

speaker: YOU
text: Talent.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your best friend has pranked you for years. Payback time.

speaker: FRIEND
text: BRO! When did you even...

speaker: YOU
text: I've been standing here the whole time.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Then one day, it isn't funny anymore.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: A car runs a red light. A kid on a bike is right in front of it.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Ten seconds. You run.

speaker: KID
text: ...How did I get over here?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Nobody saw a thing.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The next morning, you pause time like always.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: But someone across the street... is still moving.

speaker: GIRL
text: Took you long enough.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You're not the only one.

speaker: NARRATOR
